dh_perenolde.accept_text:
The Lord's Hall, at the heart of the ring. You've done the work that makes this possible and I'd rather you knew it: without the fence's ledger and the magister's postings I'd have sent you in to kill a squatter.

Alterac sold the Alliance to the Horde and his father signed it. The Alliance dissolved the kingdom and left the family their titles, because titles cost nothing. This is what fifteen years of carrying a title and no country does to a man.

Durnholde Keep is south-east of Tarren Mill, off the east road. You know the archway.

dh_yvaine.accept_text: Durnholde Keep, south-east of Tarren Mill. Her tower is the west one, off the ring. One door, no other way out, which cuts both ways.

dg_morgrin.accept_text: Dun Garok, the dwarven fort cut into the ridge at the south end of the valley. Past the Great Hall, at the vault door.
